text:
Sam (Support): Hey team — customer AcmePayments reports intermittent 5xxs and long timeouts hitting hosted generate + embed endpoints starting ~08:10 UTC. They see lots of 503/504s and SDK retry storms, billing spike. Repro steps below, sample request_id: r_0a9f2b.

Priya (Customer Success): Thanks Sam. Customer wants ETA and any temporary mitigations we can suggest. Can we confirm it's not auth related?

Sam (Support): Auth looks fine — token validations passed. Repro (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"<...>","max_tokens":1024}' \
  --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 30
```
They also batch 6 embed requests concurrently via our python SDK which by default retries on 5xx. They saw p95 >8s then 504.

Lena (Eng Oncall): Can you paste 2–3 full request_ids and the edge/gateway logs (nginx/ingress)? Need to know if it's upstream model latency or ingress queueing. Also, is this in us-west-2?

Sam (Support): Region: us-west-2. Additional request_ids: r_0a9f2b, r_b14f77, r_c33dd0. Excerpt from gateway logs: 
```
[08:11:02] proxy upstream r_0a9f2b -> 502, upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out)
[08:11:03] upstream state change: overloaded pool
[08:11:04] request r_b14f77 queued, queue_len=73
[08:12:10] request r_c33dd0 -> 504, client deadline exceeded
```

InfraBot: ALERT: Ingress 5xx rate increased by 260% in us-west-2 between 08:05-08:15 UTC. Autoscaler triggered burst nodes + coldstart count +12.

Lena (Eng Oncall): Looks like ingress queueing + coldstart churn. Two actionable items: (1) short-term mitigation: reduce client parallelism & disable aggressive SDK retries to avoid retry storm; (2) medium-term: pin customer to Dedicated pool or enable faster warm pools for rwd-3b.

Sam (Support): Suggested message to customer: "We're investigating a regional ingress surge causing queued requests and increased timeouts. Temporary mitigations: reduce parallel requests by half, set SDK retry max_retries=1, implement exponential backoff (min 200ms). We'll update when we have a root cause." Want me to send?

Priya (Customer Success): Yes please send that now + offer a rollback to previous model version (if they want) and 3 days of invoice credit for impacted tokens. Ask if they can throttle while we stabilize.

Lena (Eng Oncall): For repro: capture one failing session with full client trace (enable SDK DEBUG logging) and include headers X-Request-Id, X-Forwarded-For, and connection pool stats. If they can run a reduced-rate test (single-threaded, 1 rps) that will tell us whether model backend is slow vs ingress saturation.

Sam (Support): Posted temp mitigation + credit offer to customer. They replied: "OK reducing concurrency, will send SDK logs in ~30m."

Lena (Eng Oncall): I'll open a short-term ingress smoothing rollout in us-west-2 (bump queue depth and warm pool). ETA ~40m. I'll post update after rollout.

InfraBot: Maintenance ticket INF-4621 created (ingress smoothing us-west-2). Change window 08:45-09:25 UTC.

Priya (Customer Success): Thanks — I'll keep AcmePayments in the loop and mark as high priority. :thumbsup:

Sam (Support): Closing loop here for now. Will add follow-ups when we have post-mitigation metrics & customer logs.

Lena (Eng Oncall): Follow-up checklist for post-mitigation: 1) compare p95 latency pre/post, 2) check coldstart count, 3) verify no elevated retry billing.

Sam (Support): Noted. If customer logs show many client retries, we'll coordinate with Billing to adjust for double-charging.

Priya (Customer Success): Customer sent SDK logs (uploaded to gist). They show repeated 5xx then immediate retry. I'll attach link in ticket.

Lena (Eng Oncall): Good. Once we confirm ingress smoothing reduced queue_len and p95 < 1.5s, we'll recommend enabling SDK client-side bounded concurrency and increasing keepalive reuse.

Sam (Support): Update 09:10 UTC: ingress smoothing deployed, observed queue_len drop to <10 and 5xx rate back to baseline. Customer reduced concurrency and reports successful requests. Closing as mitigated — will keep open until billing review. :white_check_mark:
